artifacts.name: SocialLinks
artifacts.description:
Social action buttons for the popup. Clicking the expert-help button
sends a guarded fire-and-forget ANALYTICS_EVENT extension_event
runtime message (nested eventType adc_fix_link_clicked with
link_location popup_home and the resolved link_url) and then opens
HELP_LINK in a new tab. The HELP_LINK default is the UTM-tagged ADC
Fix URL; explicit HELP_LINK props are opened unchanged. All other
buttons keep their existing behavior.

artifacts.name: should send an adc_fix_link_clicked analytics event when help is clicked
artifacts.description: Verifies the help click sends the ANALYTICS_EVENT extension_event message with adc_fix_link_clicked details and still opens the link.

artifacts.name: should default the help link to the UTM-tagged ADC Fix URL
artifacts.description: Verifies that without a HELP_LINK prop the opened URL is the ADC Fix URL with extension/popup/expert_help UTM parameters.

artifacts.name: should still open the help link when analytics messaging is unavailable
artifacts.description: Verifies the help tab opens even when chrome.runtime is missing so analytics can never block the CTA.
